summary: security-guardian's round-1 MEDIUM used E7 (advisory-artifact + author-controlled-input cap) -- orchestrator determined this was a MISAPPLICATION: E7 requires BOTH conjuncts (documented-advisory artifact, AND author-controlled input never reachable from a production request) and this fails both (a production audit row is not an advisory linter; the input is reachable from any authenticated production caller with no special grant). Corrected derivation: I1 base HIGH, E3 no-change, no valid cap applies -> HIGH/BLOCKING, matching compliance-officer's independent round-1 derivation and security-guardian's own stated I1/E3 facts once the E7 error is removed. unhappy-path (UP-12) and consistency-auditor independently confirmed reachability/exploitability in the same parallel wave without being shown each other's analysis. All Gate-8 round-1 agents (12) were shown the junior-developer's self-report as 'PRIMARY FOCUS' context per the orchestrator's prompt, so they are ECHOES for the fact of the gap's EXISTENCE (independent_reporters=1, the self-identifying implementer) but each independently DERIVED severity/reachability, which is recorded as corroboration in this summary, not as additional independent_reporters per the shared preamble's was-shown-it rule.
classification_rationale: new code bypasses an established in-file sanitizer for the identical pattern; standing rule 3's security-adjacent-code exception applies natively (this IS the security code, not adjacent to it)
adjudication_rationale: E7's two conjuncts read literally against the shared preamble's own text: 'documented ADVISORY... never gates CI or a merge on its own' and 'author-controlled... never reachable from an external actor, a production request, or production data' -- both fail for a production audit row reachable via an authenticated API call. Corrected band HIGH/BLOCKING, matching compliance-officer's independent derivation and the shared preamble's own closing warning ('a wrongly-applied E7 silently downgrades a reachable defect').
